mapper.select: select id, device_id, last_app, app_time, del_flag, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time from t_device_app where device_id = #{deviceId} and last_app = #{app} and del_flag = 'N' limit 1

select tda.device_id as deviceId, td.device_no as deviceNo, td.device_name as deviceName, td.device_charge as deviceCharge, tda.last_app as app, tda.app_time as appTime from t_device_app tda inner join t_device td on tda.device_id = td.id where tda.del_flag = 'N' and td.device_status = 'using' and tda.app_time < #{updateRemindTime}
